latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of academic-formula-converter.
- Converts LaTeX formulas in Markdown to Unicode for improved readability.
- Exports Markdown with formulas and images to docx (Word) and styled HTML formats.
- Supports both inline `$formula$` and block `$$formula$$` math syntax.
- Provides command line interface for file conversion and image directory specification.
- Includes sample LaTeX-to-Unicode mappings and installation instructions.
